description: BD ORTHO® Historique - Seine-Maritime is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The BD ORTHO® Historical product is a collection of digital mosaics of ancient panchromatic orthophotographs (grey levels) rectified in the projection adapted to the covered territory. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "BD ORTHO® History — Seine-Maritime" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ortho-imagerie. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
